analysis.executiveSummary: Big Balder Brand can leverage foundation asset Jaxson Dart alongside surplus bench receiver Chris Godwin to target S-tier quarterback Jayden Daniels from DMV Fantasy. In a 16-team 1QB format, Daniels provides slate-breaking weekly upside (95.9 C-AVI / 322.6 projected PPR points). Because DMV Fantasy has urgent starting WR/FLEX depth needs and only Aaron Rodgers behind Daniels, sending Dart (82.4 C-AVI / 310.3 projected points) alongside Godwin (62.1 C-AVI) addresses DMV's lineup hole while maintaining a top-10 fantasy QB starter for them, yielding a highly realistic proposal path (74% acceptance probability).
